name: Endroll ni Watashi no Namae ga Nai
original_name: エンドロールにワタシの名前がない
source:
Kuzuki Yorito, the protagonist, is a student teacher.
However, the school he's training at turns out to be an all-girls school!?
Seeing as he has poor communication skills, Kuzuki makes a pact with a devil to gather profiles on the schoolgirls.

Coinciding with the start of Kuzuki’s internship, a transfer student named Chitose Kuji arrives in his assigned class. Chitose is a timid, "small animal"-type girl who keeps everyone at an extreme distance.

Will Kuzuki be able to gather information on her?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13623]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
主人公葛木赖人是一名实习老师。
然而他所就读的学校竟然是女子学校！？
由于沟通能力差，葛木与恶魔签订了协议，收集女学生的个人资料。

就在葛木的实习开始之际，一位名叫久地千登势的转校生来到了他指定的班级。千岁是一个胆怯的“小动物”型女孩，与每个人都保持着极远的距离。

葛木能收集到她的情报吗？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13623]Novelgame[/url]]
